rationale: Option B is the more rigorous design (indirect evals plus a control trained on repeated 'false' documents), which directly isolates salience/repetition. But the persona favors cheap, lightweight, portable checks, and Option A adds diagnostics to existing evaluations without new training runs. Option A matches the persona's cost-consciousness while B matches the scientific logic, so it is close to even, with a slight lean to B because the control addresses the repetition concern directly.
